project_value_period_order.name: project_value_period_order
project_value_period_order.value: "project"."value_period_start" is null or "project"."value_period_end" is null or "project"."value_period_start" <= "project"."value_period_end"

value_case_version_kind_shape.name: value_case_version_kind_shape
value_case_version_kind_shape.value:
("value_case_version"."kind" = 'inherited_business_case' and "value_case_version"."version_number" = 0 and "value_case_version"."status" in ('draft', 'recorded'))
       or ("value_case_version"."kind" = 'value_case' and "value_case_version"."version_number" >= 1 and "value_case_version"."status" <> 'recorded' and "value_case_version"."stated_total_value" is null)

value_case_version_proposed_shape.name: value_case_version_proposed_shape
value_case_version_proposed_shape.value: "value_case_version"."status" not in ('proposed', 'authorised', 'superseded') or ("value_case_version"."proposed_at" is not null and "value_case_version"."proposed_by" is not null)

value_case_version_authorised_shape.name: value_case_version_authorised_shape
value_case_version_authorised_shape.value:
"value_case_version"."status" not in ('authorised', 'superseded') or (
            "value_case_version"."authorised_on" is not null and "value_case_version"."authorised_by_person_id" is not null
        and "value_case_version"."authorisation_evidence_id" is not null and "value_case_version"."authorisation_recorded_by" is not null
        and "value_case_version"."authorisation_recorded_at" is not null)

value_driver_version_benefit_dates_order.name: value_driver_version_benefit_dates_order
value_driver_version_benefit_dates_order.value: "value_driver_version"."benefit_start_date" is null or "value_driver_version"."benefit_full_date" is null or "value_driver_version"."benefit_start_date" <= "value_driver_version"."benefit_full_date"
